Class AnahataUcUtils

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.nb.uc.AnahataUcUtils
public final class AnahataUcUtils extends Object
Universal utility class for managing NetBeans version detection, Anahata ASI Update Centers (Universal, Stable, and Dev Snapshot), URL connectivity checks, legacy update center cleanup, and automated installation of Anahata ASI Studio and JavaFX runtimes.
Author:
anahata

    • registerDefaultUpdateCenters

      public static void registerDefaultUpdateCenters()
      Registers all standard Anahata Update Centers in NetBeans if not already registered.

      - Universal Update Center: Registered and enabled by default. - Stable Update Center: Registered and enabled by default. - Dev Snapshot Update Center: Registered in a disabled state by default.

    • getJavaFxFormattedStatus

      public static String getJavaFxFormattedStatus()
      Resolves the formatted JavaFX status string for NetBeans environment display.

      Returns "Version (JDK)" if provided by the host JVM, "Version (NB Module)" if provided by a NetBeans module, or "Not available" if absent.

      Returns:
      The formatted JavaFX status string.

    • isSystemJdkJavaFx

      public static boolean isSystemJdkJavaFx()
      Checks whether JavaFX is bundled directly in the host system JDK (e.g., Liberica Full JDK or Azul Zulu FX).

      Because this module does not declare a module dependency on NetBeans' JavaFX module, standard Class.forName("javafx.application.Platform") will ONLY find JavaFX if it is provided by the underlying JDK.

      Returns:
      true if JavaFX classes are available directly from the host JDK.
